watches.name: Kalbu: M.O.P. - Mawar
watches.description: The Kalbu: M.O.P. - Mawar dial is an ode to the equatorial horizon. It captures the softest, most romantic light of the day. Its warm, rosy hue is like a breathtaking moment on the horizon, reflecting the tender pinks of both an archipelago sunrise and a tropical sunset. This variant embodies a rare beauty found in moments of tranquillity and hope, reminding us that every journey, no matter how long, has a serene and beautiful reward. The natural iridescence of the M.O.P. ensures that extreme light-play is constantly accentuated; at certain angles, the dial takes on deep, nuanced tones of lavender and soft gold, complementing the warm, rosy hue. This complex interplay of light, magnified through the sapphire glass, embodies the Kalbu—the inner, centred soul—and reminds us that true strength is found not just in clarity, but in balance, beauty, and emotional depth. **Due to the extreme demands of machining the intricate 'pucuk rebung' hour hand and 'bunga pecah lapan' minute hand, the manufacturing process was pushed to its limits to ensure absolute precision. To maintain the quality of these components, the Kalbu: M.O.P. - Mawar is limited to a total of 100 pieces worldwide and will not be repeated. From S$550 excluding GST/VAT/Tariffs/Duties Limited edition release of 100 pieces per variant ONLY All purchases are final and cannot be cancelled Please note that any local import duties, VAT, or customs taxes are the responsibility of the recipient and will be collected by the courier upon arrival.
